title: Acoustic Synchronization of Dha (Ge + Na Compound Stroke)
summary: Bimanual synchronization of the bass Bayan modulation with the treble Dayan rim stroke to produce a singular resonant acoustic timbre.

claims.statement: Step 1: The flat wrist heel slide on the Bayan (Ge) and the index finger rim strike on the Dayan (Na) must impact within +/- 15ms.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: The flat wrist heel slide on the Bayan (Ge) and the index finger rim strike on the Dayan (Na) must impact within +/- 15ms.

claims.statement: Step 2: Simultaneous strike generates a composite acoustic spectrum combining 85Hz bass modulation with 440Hz ringing harmonic overtone.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Simultaneous strike generates a composite acoustic spectrum combining 85Hz bass modulation with 440Hz ringing harmonic overtone.
